content: गुणिन् {%a.%} [गुण-इन्] .²1 Possessed of or endowed with merits, meritorious; गुणी गुणं वेत्ति न वेत्ति निर्गुणः; <ls>Ms. 8. 73</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 78</ls>. .²2 Good, auspicious; गुणिन्यहनि <ls>Dk. 61</ls>. .²3 Familiar with the merits of anything. .²4 Possessing qualities (as an object); गुणानां गुणिनां चैव परिणाममभीप्सताम् <ls>Bhāg. 2. 8. 14</ls>. .²5 Possessed of the three qualities; <ls>Ve. 6. 43</ls>. .²6 Having (subordinate) parts, principal (<ab>Opp.</ab> गुण); गुणगुणिनोरेव सम्बन्धः. .{@-नी@} A bow.
